description: This file implements a maze game using the Matter.js physics engine. It sets up the game environment, generates a maze with walls, manages object movement via keyboard input, and handles win condition detection with collision events.
external_files: matter.js library (implied by usage of Matter object)

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly shuffles an array in place.

methods.name: recurse
methods.description: Recursively generates maze paths by visiting grid cells and removing walls.
